reader.notes: Every OPEN outcome passes the one FileConnector#Status setter and EmitOpen stores it into the FILE STATUS item after each file's open. At 85 the two edition arms (no sharing facility, physical-file lock) give the 85 statuses, as probed.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR23 (cite.py: OK  §1985:VII.4.3.4 GR23 the text is in GR23) and the whole OPEN status list of §1985:VII.1.3.5 (00, 05, 07, 30, 35, 37, 38, 39, 41, 9x). Attacked what the reader did not reach: 37, and a 2023-only OPEN status leaking at 85. r23_perm.cob, a read-only ro.dat: RO-OUTPUT=37 RO-EXTEND=37 RO-IO=37, then RO-INPUT=00 RO-READ=00 ABCD, so the file was untouched (GR26). This is VII.1.3.5 3d 1 (cite.py: OK §1985:VII.1.3.5, it lies in GRL2.3d.1). OPEN OUTPUT on a directory gave 37 and OPEN INPUT on a directory gave 35; where more than one value applies the implementor chooses (cite.py: OK §1985:VII.1.3.5, it lies in GR5). Class c: the runtime's only 2023-only OPEN status, '31' (FileConnector#AssociationFailure), is reachable only through ASSIGN USING. r23_using.cob is refused at --std 85 with COBOL0900. In r23_dyn.cob, ASSIGN TO WS-NAME with WS-NAME = SPACES opened 00 with no '31'. The reader's probe already showed no '61' at 85.
